description: Ranked market table — top coins sorted by market cap, volume, or 24h price change, optionally filtered to a category. The entry point for "top 20 DeFi coins" or "biggest gainers today". Returns standard market fields per coin (price, cap, volume, supply, 24h/1h/7d change, ATH/ATL). Discover valid category slugs with coingecko_list_categories and pass the category_id exactly.

category.description: Restrict to a category slug from coingecko_list_categories (e.g. "layer-1", "decentralized-finance-defi"). Omit for all coins.

order.description: Sort order. Use price_change_percentage_24h_desc for top gainers, _asc for top losers.

page.description: 1-based page number for paging beyond per_page rows.

vs_currency.description: Currency to denominate the table in (e.g. "usd", "eur", "btc"). Single currency.

name: coingecko_list_markets

cap.description: The per_page cap applied. Present only when the page is full.

coins.description: Ranked market rows for this page. Data provided by CoinGecko.

ath.description: All-time-high price in vs_currency, when available.

atl.description: All-time-low price in vs_currency, when available.

currentPrice.description: Current price in vs_currency, when available.

high24h.description: 24-hour high price in vs_currency, when available.

low24h.description: 24-hour low price in vs_currency, when available.

marketCap.description: Market capitalization in vs_currency, when available.

totalVolume.description: 24-hour trading volume in vs_currency, when available.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_category`: A category was supplied but the result was empty — the slug is not recognized upstream (CoinGecko returns empty rather than erroring on a bad category). `rate_limited`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 429 — the shared keyless pool is throttled, or the Demo-tier quota was hit. `upstream_unreachable`: CoinGecko was unreachable or returned a 5xx/HTML error after all retry attempts. `invalid_response`: CoinGecko returned a body that could not be parsed as JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

shown.description: Rows returned on this page. Present only when the page is full.

truncated.description: True when the page filled to per_page (more rows likely on the next page). Present only when the page is full.

title: coingecko-mcp-server: list markets
